text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As per yearly tradition, it's time for
Tracen's summer camp. The
change of
scenery has Bamboo fired up more than
ever.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Get that blood boiling for an extra red-hot step ten! Feel that summer heat and ruuun!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... So, what do you think of those
sand sprints?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yesss! Sand takes more leg strength to run
than normal tracks, but it's
nice not having
to worry so much about my nails.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Those two—aren't they the ones
from the arcade that one
time?

text_block_list.name: Arcade Duo
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ At this pace, we'll smash through
the assignment early.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We did plenty of training, so I say
we wrap up and have some
fun!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Heh. Breaktime is important too.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I've still got plenty of energy for
another
lap, though!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh? They still haven't come back?

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text:
No... I've been messaging them, but they
haven't replied.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm, I've got a bad feeling about this!
Did they say anything
about where they
were going?

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text:
Not really... But this afternoon,
I saw a man start a conversation with
them. He was
saying he could show them around some
fun places in the area...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: THAT'S OUR PERP!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Rest assured,
the disciplinary committee is
here to keep students safe!
I'll go save
them!

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text: Wait! We should tell an adult first!

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text:
We're supposed to get a trainer, right?
Um, I think Bamboo's trainer
was...

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Umm... Are you sure this is okay?

text_block_list.name: Shallow Man
text_block_list.text:
It's fiiine.
No one'll notice if you're back a
bit late.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Stop right there!
I know what you're up to!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And you two—you're not getting off with a
warning this time! C'mon,
I'm taking you
back!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: Not the fun police... Just leave us alone!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm not here to take away your free time.
It's just as important as
running, right? I
know I wouldn't want to give up my kendo
time...

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I reconsidered a lot of stuff since last
time.
And now, I get why having
time to play is
so essential.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But what you're doing right now is
dangerous. That man could take
both
racing and leisure away from you! And I
can't let that happen!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
W-what we do is none of your business!
We're not taking orders from
some jerk
who doesn't even know us!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...I'll admit, I may not know much about
you or your hobbies.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But even so, deep down... I know you're just like me. You wanna run, and you wanna win!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If all you cared about was having fun, you
could've quit racing. But
you didn't. You
stuck it out through all the rigorous
training!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Because you've both got dreams! You've
got races you wanna win! And if you invite
trouble here, all the work you've done'll
go down
the drain...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I won't ever let that happen!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: Chairman...

text_block_list.name: Shallow Man
text_block_list.text:
Blegh, am I watching a kid's show or
something? That motivational
sports crap
was dumb, even for a toddler.

text_block_list.name: Shallow Man
text_block_list.text:
These little ladies here already said
they'd
rather be out having fun.
C'mon, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait! Stop!

text_block_list.name: Shallow Man
text_block_list.text:
Let go! ...Damn it, you made me drop
everything!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
What are all these notes? "Tracen Elites
Ditch Camp for Local
Nightlife"?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It looks like his phone's been recording
everything you said... I see
how it is. You're
some tabloid jerk trying to stir up
trouble!

text_block_list.name: Shallow Man
text_block_list.text: You brat... Give that back!

text_block_list.name: Policeman
text_block_list.text: Put your hands up! This is the police!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as the man starts to lunge at Bamboo
for the phone, our shouts startle him just
long enough for the officer to grab him.
I'm so glad we
made it in time...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer?! And a police officer?

text_block_list.name: Policeman
text_block_list.text: I'm going to take this man in for questioning. ...And you are gonna have a lot to answer for at the station!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: I-I was so scared!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's okay now! Discipline and order have
been restored!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh, I-I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: Heh, who's the rule-breaker now?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Sh-shut up! I wouldn't be out here if you hadn't—

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: It's fine, we get it. We messed up bad, and you really were just trying to help us.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think we learned our lesson with
this one. And, uh... you're not
exactly
wrong... We do have dreams.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to hear it!
Let's all keep running
strong and steady towards
those goals!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following the close call,
the rule-breaking pair amend their ways.
Everyone puts their
heart and soul into training—and into
enjoying the festival and fireworks
afterwards!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hm! Y'know what? "Work hard, play
hard" really is the way to go!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I'll uphold all the rules perfectly,
get plenty of rest and
relaxation, and then I'll
win all my races when we get home from 
camp!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But, uh... If I do anything dumb like the
other night, don't hesitate to
put me back
on track.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Got it?! I'm looking forward to LOTS more
red-hot training with you!
